{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
data = data[data['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Remove refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
data = data[data['status'] == 'completed']

# Verify data is clean
print(f"Number of rows after cleaning: {len(data)}")
print(f"Number of QA orders removed: {900 - len(data)}")
print(f"Number of refunded orders removed: {900 - len(data) - 6}")

# Check for missing revenue or converted
print(f"Missing revenue: {data['revenue'].isnull().sum()}")
print(f"Missing converted: {data['converted'].isnull().sum()}")"}
